item.title: CPI Data set to show steady US inflation in December, still above Fed’s target
item.description: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) will publish December’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) report on Tuesday at 13:30 GMT. The report is expected to show that prices remained broadly stable in the last month of 2025.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains subdued as US Dollar steadies on market caution
item.description: The Australian Dollar declines against the US Dollar on Tuesday following the release of Australia’s Westpac Consumer Confidence, which fell 1.7% month-over-month (MoM) in January to a three-month low of 92.9, extending December’s sharp 9.0% drop amid shifting rate expectations.

item.title: USD/INR opens slightly higher in countdown to US-India trade talks
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday at around 90.52, ahead of trade talks between the United States (US) and India during the day.

item.title: Japanese Yen selling remains unabated; USD/JPY rallies to July 2024 high
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) selling bias remains unabated through the Asian session, which, along with a modest US Dollar (USD) uptick, lifts the USD/JPY pair to the 159.00 neighborhood, or the highest level since July 2024.

item.title: Gold consolidates below $4,600, remains close to record high as US CPI report looms
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) is seen consolidating below the all-time peak, touched the previous day, and the $4,600 mark during the Asian session on Tuesday as traders opt to wait for the release of the latest US consumer inflation figures.

item.title: USD/CHF dips to near 0.7950 as safe-haven demand supports Swiss Franc
item.description: USD/CHF loses ground for the second successive day, trading around 0.7970 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair depreciates as the Swiss Franc (CHF) receives support from safe-haven demand amid geopolitical tensions and concerns over Federal Reserve (Fed) independence.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Holds gains above 185.00, bullish momentum prevails
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross trades in positive territory for the third consecutive day near 185.20 during the early European session on Tuesday.

item.title: Netherlands, The Consumer Price Index n.s.a (YoY) declined to 2.8% in December from previous 2.9%
item.description: Netherlands, The Consumer Price Index n.s.a (YoY) declined to 2.8% in December from previous 2.9%

item.title: EUR/GBP trades calm near 0.8650 while investors await UK GDP data
item.description: The EUR/GBP pair trades in a tight range around 0.8650 during the European trading session on Tuesday. The pair consolidates while investors gauge fresh cues about how monetary policy policies by the Bank of England (BoE) and the European Central Bank (ECB) will flair in the near term.

item.title: GBP/JPY advances to 214.00 mark, highest since August 2008 amid notable JPY weakness
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross builds on the previous day's breakout momentum through a nearly three-week-old range and gains follow-through positive traction for the third consecutive day on Tuesday.
